observation.command:
cd /workspace
echo "=== did original commit 520d93f ship any uv.lock? ==="
git ls-tree -r 520d93f --name-only | grep -c "uv.lock"
echo "=== sqlalchemy version in original pyprojects (any pin?) ==="
git show 520d93f:02-backend/ki-guv-feedback/pyproject.toml 2>/dev/null | grep -iE "sqlalchemy|psycopg" 
echo "=== which services pin ONLY psycopg2 (no psycopg v3) AND got sqlalchemy 2.1.x ==="
for d in 02-backend/*/; do s=$(basename $d); [ -f $d/pyproject.toml ] || continue; has2=$(grep -c "psycopg2-binary" $d/pyproject.toml); has3=$(grep -cE '"psycopg(\[binary\])?[=<>~ ]' $d/pyproject.toml); va=$(grep -A2 'name = "sqlalchemy"' $d/uv.lock 2>/dev/null | grep version | head -1 | awk '{print $3}'); if [ "$has2" -gt 0 ] && [ "$has3" -eq 0 ] && echo "$va" | grep -q "2.1"; then echo "AFFECTED: $s (sqlalchemy $va)"; fi; done
